description: This file manages data encoding, encryption, scene loading, and sharing functionalities for an Excalidraw-based application, including collaboration link generation, scene import/export, and data synchronization.

classes.name: SyncableExcalidrawElement
classes.description: A type representing an Excalidraw element that can be synchronized, extending OrderedExcalidrawElement with branding.

methods.name: isSyncableElement
methods.description: Determines if an element is eligible for synchronization based on deletion status and size.

methods.name: getSyncableElements
methods.description: Filters a list of elements to return only those that are syncable.

methods.name: generateRoomId
methods.description: Generates a random hexadecimal string to be used as a room ID.

methods.name: legacy_decodeFromBackend
methods.description: Decodes share link data from the backend using a legacy buffer format, handling decryption and backward compatibility.

methods.name: importFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches and decrypts scene data from the backend, handling decompression and errors.

methods.name: loadScene
methods.description: Loads a scene from backend or local data, restoring elements, app state, and files.

methods.name: exportToBackend
methods.description: Compresses, encrypts, and uploads scene data and files to the backend, returning a shareable URL or error message.
